newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to pass extra budget in January - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan to pass extra budget in January - MOF.

text.p: The Japanese government plans to pass a supplementary budget for the fiscal year to March 31 at the beginning of an ordinary parliament session due to be convened in January, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.

Mitsuzuka did not say what the size of the extra budget would be or if it would finance public works projects to stimulate the economy. An extraordinary parliament session is due to start on Friday this week.
"We will handle the supplementary budget at the outset of the next ordinary parliament session," he said.
